notes: Index of the guide sections and activity sets (titles). The site is moving to www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/. The guide pages state the equations (lift, drag, isentropic, shock, nozzle, standard atmosphere) as NASA writes them; the activities are written by contributing teachers (grades 6–12), so they are recorded as types only.

units.title: Beginner's Guide to Aerodynamics (lift, drag, wing geometry, Mach number, standard atmosphere)
Aerodynamics activities (grades 6–12): lift and velocity, Mach number, elliptical wing, trimmed aircraft, pitot tube, range, density and lift
Beginner's Guide to Propulsion (turbojet, turbofan, ramjet, nozzles, thrust)
Propulsion activities (grades 6–12): drag equation, forces in a climb, climb vectors
Beginner's Guide to Model Rockets (thrust, stability, flight)
Interactive simulators (FoilSim, EngineSim, Oblique Shock, ShockModeler, RocketNozzle)
